S5_AB_quotient.why: the endpoint pair is unordered and canonicalised per founder by sorted site-id lists; channel A of one founder has no a-priori relation to channel A of another. Fitting one affine family across founders requires an orientation first.

gauge.reason: lexicographically first BASIS founder; fixing one founder removes the global sign degeneracy, which is not identifiable and never will be.

enumeration.objective: exact weighted residual of the one-mode model, trace(G) - lambda_1(G)

S8_affine_family.model: S1 = { mu + a * phi1 }, one free scalar a per cell, fitted on the 12 oriented carrier BASIS cells in the sqrt(w)-weighted two-channel coordinate.

definitions.OFF1_centered: ||r - mu - a*phi1||_w / ||r - mu||_w  -- the STRICT reading, and the one the gate uses. It asks what fraction of a cell's DEVIATION from the common response is unexplained by the single mode.
definitions.OFF1_uncentered: ||r - mu - a*phi1||_w / ||r||_w -- reported only because it is the flattering reading; it is not gated on.
definitions.O_BASIS: total unexplained centered energy fraction = 1 - lambda_1/trace(G)

uniqueness_proof: The parent manifest names exactly one canonical_sentinel_instance per TRAIN superfamily, and no other instance appears anywhere in the parent's scored path.
The parent's executable make_ops() constructs exactly two operators and no more.
The parent's 12 scored cells are exactly 6 founders x these 2 sentinels.
